messages:
tara: quick sync - for rerank API should we expose scores as normalized [0..1] only or also provide raw logits? thinking about routing, console charts, and quota math.

priya: normalized 0..1 is better for customers and console. but keep raw_logit available internally or opt-in for debugging.

mike: routing needs consistent thresholds across models. raw logits help, but we can maintain mapping inside model meta to normalized thresholds.

sam: ops: meter on returned candidates by default. add small surcharge if raw included (e.g. +0.15/unit) to account for extra bytes.

anya: console wants stable y-axis; normalized primary chart, raw histogram as optional sampled view. add score_schema_version so we can change mapping later.

tara: proposed contract: required fields = score (0..1), score_kind (enum), score_schema_version (string). optional raw_logit only when header X-Include-Raw:true AND tenant allowed.

priya: telemetry: emit model_tag, requested_count, returned_count, p50/p90(normalized), sampled_raw_histogram (0.1%).

mike: also store effective_thresholds per model (raw <-> normalized) for routing audits.

sam: action: update quota doc with formula: cost = base + returned_count * unit_cost + (include_raw ? returned_count*0.15 : 0).

tara: i'll open the API PR and console mock. tagging @priya @mike @sam for review.
